actors.name: Professor Ilse Brandt
actors.private_context: Ilse is a professor at Ashvale University. She remembers Kofi Asante as a strong student in her seminars, but they have not spoken in eight months. She is busy and receives many requests for references; she prioritizes those from students she remembers well and that are polite and specific.

actors.name: Kofi Asante
actors.private_context: Kofi is a former student of Ilse Brandt. He took two of her seminars and earned top marks. He has drafted a polite and specific message asking for a reference letter for a museum fellowship due in three weeks. He intends to send it to Ilse.

shared_context: Kofi Asante has a message prepared to send to Professor Ilse Brandt via email. Ilse Brandt can receive and read emails. The fellowship deadline is in three weeks from the simulation start time.

starting_events.description: Kofi Asante sends his message requesting a reference letter to Professor Ilse Brandt.

resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that Professor Ilse Brandt sent a reply to Kofi Asante's message before 2026-08-10T10:00:00+01:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
